subject: Action ledger & approval sprint for Sable Tech MPA
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@sabletech.com>; David Han <david.han@sabletech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Action ledger & approval sprint for Sable Tech MPA

Hi Elaine / David —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard and the proposed mutual action plan (high level) so we stay aligned on owners and dates. I’ve kept this intentionally concise so your procurement and exec teams can scan.

Key pain & goals you reiterated
- Latency spikes on nightly batch enrichment causing timeouts for downstream features (primary pain).
- Cost unpredictability as models scaled — goal is predictable per-token economics for production.
- Need for VPC/private deployment for regulated PII flows (must support Express route by legal).

What success looks like (agreed)
1) Pilot running on representative dataset with avg tail latency < 300ms and cost estimate +/- 10% by pilot end.
2) Security evidence (SOC2 + encrypted at rest + KMS) validated by procurement.
3) Clear approval path and PO by 11/12/2026 to start reserved capacity in Dec.

Proposed milestone sprint (owners & dates) — details attached in the MPA draft (Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf):
- 10/06 — Technical deep-dive: Redwood runtime walkthrough + sample perf on a 10k record slice (Owner: Ben).
- 10/13 — Security package delivery: SOC2 summary + encryption/KMS architecture (Owner: Marissa).
- 10/20 — Exec sync (David + Elaine + Redwood Sales + Solutions) to confirm PO runway and pricing (Owner: Elaine / Marissa).
- 11/12 — Procurement sign-off and PO submitted (Owner: Sable procurement).

Open asks for your team before the tech deep-dive:
- Can you confirm a sample dataset slice (anonymized) and estimated QPS for the pilot?
- Who is the procurement POC to receive the PO template (I’ve attached a PO_template.docx)?

Attachments: Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf (draft mutual action plan), PO_template.docx

If helpful, I can bake the procurement flow and sample acceptance criteria into the MPA after the deep-dive. Next step: Ben to schedule the 10/06 deep-dive — Ben, can you propose two time slots?

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0189

--
Redwood Inference — production-first AI inference for developers

Date: 2026-10-03T16:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action ledger & approval sprint for Sable Tech MPA

Marissa —

Appreciate the concise plan, that format is perfect for our execs. Quick answers:
- I’ll send an anonymized 10k-record slice by EOD Tuesday (10/05). It will include median/tail latency examples and a short description of our current enrichment pipeline.
- Procurement POC: procurement@sabletech.com (cc’d) — their legal will need the SOC2 artifacts and the KMS architecture diagram.
- For the exec sync, David will join; I’ll block 10/20 afternoon.

We can aim for PO by 11/12 but need to validate pricing alignment after the perf run. Also cc’ing procurement to start an initial review of the PO_template.docx.

— Elaine

elaine@sabletech.com | +1 212-555-4410

Date: 2026-10-04T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action ledger & approval sprint for Sable Tech MPA

Thanks — I’ll propose two slots for the technical deep-dive (10/06 9:00–10:00 PT or 10/06 13:00–14:00 PT) and include a lightweight perf checklist in the calendar invite:
- Representative sample latency profile (p95/p99)
- Typical input sequence lengths and tokenization notes
- Expected QPS in pilot + concurrency profile
- Any guardrails or prompt templates you’ll run in pilot

I’ll also attach a short test-run script and a performance snapshot template so the sample deliverable is plug-and-play. Also planning to bring Karthik to cover quantization/instance sizing questions.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@sabletech.com>, procurement@sabletech.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action ledger & approval sprint for Sable Tech MPA

Great — thanks for the quick replies and for looping procurement. I updated the MPA draft (attached: Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf) with owners and acceptance criteria from today’s notes. Key items I added:
- Acceptance criteria for pilot perf: avg tail latency target (p99) < 350ms; end-to-end throughput target to support stated QPS; no impact to upstream job schedules.
- Security deliverables: SOC2 evidence, KMS key rotation policy, network diagram for the VPC/private deployment. I also included a short rollback plan if latency targets aren’t met during the pilot window.

Next actions (owner + due):
- Sable: share anonymized sample slice and QPS (due 2026-10-05) — Elaine.
- Redwood: run 10k sample perf and share results (due 2026-10-09) — Ben.
- Procurement: initial review of SOC2_summary.pdf + PO_template.docx (due 2026-10-13) — procurement@sabletech.com.
- Exec sync: confirm 10/20 time (Owner: Elaine) — agenda to include pricing review and go/no-go for PO prep.

If procurement confirms they need any additional artifacts (e.g., pen test report, encryption certificate), flag those in the reply and we’ll prioritize.

I’ll convert this thread into the HubSpot MPA record and share the link once created: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/87234/record/DEAL-117

Thanks again — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0189
